text: Place arrow bases of multi-parent ideas side by side across the diameter
description: Arrow base width = idea diameter × √(attribution share), but every arrow is centred on the idea, so with several parents the bases overlap instead of splitting the diameter visibly (Sankey-like). Would need each arc offset sideways by its slot; touches the elegant single-arc-centre geometry (arrow-geometry.ts, arrow shaders), so only worth it if the overlap reads badly in practice. Related: a large child feeding a small parent can get a head wider than the parent.

status.comment: arrows are transparent so their overlapping is quite fine visually. It would require a lot more of compute to support rendering some other way of rendering and still not prevent overlaps entirely - so, cancelled!
